notes:
## Dahu 0.102.8 beta

- Improved gumball handle picking while preserving the existing appearance: use the inner axis segment for scale and the outer segment or arrow for movement. Rotation handles respond along the full arc.
- Restored smooth interaction by removing the costly hover processing introduced in the previous test build.
- Clarified control-point editing scope: curves and single-face surfaces are supported; solids and multi-face polysurfaces are rejected before editing rather than offering an unreliable preview.
- Reduced temporary memory usage when encoding CAD display data and avoided whole-file copies when reading staged 3DM imports.

Known limitation: very complex 3DM files can still require excessive memory during viewport preparation. The approximately 1 GB reference case has not completed end-to-end import; this release does not claim to fix it.
